ranked_candidates.name: Append front-artwork pages near the viewport using the existing back-gallery loading mechanism
ranked_candidates.measured_problem: Normal/demanding cold journeys spend median351/1849ms waiting at page boundaries and require3/12 explicit page activations including return. Front page replacement removes96/312 choice nodes per journey. CPU samples include removeChild27.7ms; no attribution of native program time to a specific function is claimed. Back append journey waits92ms across the same72 choices.
ranked_candidates.mechanism: Retain already loaded front choices and decoded thumbnails; fetch the next page when approaching the bottom, overlapping bounded I/O with required viewing. Returning to an earlier image uses retained DOM.
ranked_candidates.prediction: At least10% and100ms reduction for normal/demanding cold journeys with no extra required-page or image requests.
risks: More live DOM and decoded image memory
Stale queries or duplicate results while appending
ranked_candidates.effort: One Svelte component, browser edge coverage, paired production-compiled measurements and native smoke
